_about: Cases where the matcher and an ISFDB scan link disagreed, settled by looking at the scan's cover and contents page (2026-10-06). 'truth' is the ISFDB pub_id the scan really is, or 'either' when ISFDB has two records for one issue.

Amazing_Stories_Quarterly_v02n04_1929-Fa.evidence: contents page: VOL. 2, OCTOBER 20, 1929, NO. 4; cover 'Fall Edition 1929'. ISFDB links it to Summer 1929.

Donald_A._Wollheim_ed._Avon_Fantasy_Read.evidence: cover 'Avon Fantasy Reader No. 11'; editor's note 'the Eleventh Avon Fantasy Reader'. ISFDB links it to No. 12.

amazing-stories-v-25n-03-1951-03.evidence: cover and spine 'Volume 25 Number 3, March 1951'. ISFDB links it to November 1951.

Planet_Stories_v02n05_1943-Wi_sas.evidence: cover 'WINTER, 1943'; ISFDB has this issue as both 'Winter 1943' and 'March 1943'.
